testcase.name: Scenario: Minimize to tabs after pinning the Modify expansion: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:523:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Minimize to tabs after pinning the Modify expansion ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible ✔ And the ribbon display policy is "Minimize to Tabs" ✔ When the user opens and pins the Modify additional command area ✔ And the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the Modify additional area remains visible ✔ When the user clicks the ribbon display control ✔ Then the ribbon is minimized to tabs ✔ And the Modify additional area is not visible ✔ When the user clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ And the user opens the Modify additional area ✔ And the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the temporary ribbon and its additional command area close ✔ When the user clicks the ribbon display control to restore the full ribbon ✔ Then the full 3D Model ribbon is displayed ✔ And the additional commands are closed ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional area ✔ And the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the additional area closes ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon remains visible
